visual_synopsis: A woman in a red top lies in bed filing her nails and chats breezily with her husband, who stands in the bedroom doorway in a grey work jacket and never comes in. Three times the film cuts to a pair of hairy male legs poking out from under the blanket at the foot of her bed, which the husband never notices before he ducks out of the doorway and leaves.
